subject: alphastorm/ninfer d125ffffd87ef38d9a221f9830e19dfa274ddd34..c5fe23dbd717c209f2ad47908ffbc423216b8890: retried transient automatic checkpoint refusals, save-before-evict, quota re-save that keeps other sessions' checkpoints, and named export refusal gates (alphastorm/omp-ninfer#45, #46)

reviews.outcome: closed for remediation: two in-scope P1s (daybreak-blue R1, R2) and one P2 (R3)

closed; every remediated finding verified red on c5fe23db and green on a4d26ccb (store regression; RTX 5090 publication-barrier tracer, docs/measurements/2026-09-24-publication-barrier.json); no in-scope P0/P1 remains

release_source.relation: a4d26ccb plus one packaging-only commit advancing the RTX 4090 lane specification, server configuration and Windows release notes to v0.6.6-beta.1; no runtime source changed

dispositions.change: Once any reclamation in a quota pass has failed, the pass never evicts another session's current checkpoint; it refuses the save (pre-publish) or leaves usage over quota by the stuck bytes (post-publish, already bounded). Two red/green store regressions.
dispositions.rationale: In-scope P1: the #46 over-deletion returns whenever one cleanup fails. Refusing the save keeps the hard cap without destroying the only copy of an evicted session; one-condition change, no new state.

dispositions.change: ResponseStore tracks responses whose record is still being published (begin at submission, end after put or when the handler gives up); the handler reports each victim Settled or Pending; a victim whose publication is pending, or whose save hit a transient gate, stays in memory and is asked for again on a later pass; a response that finished without being stored settles immediately.
dispositions.rationale: In-scope P1 for the newest-turn asset. Waiting on real publication state removes the arbitrary 2 s bound without starving admission on never-stored turns; the waiting request is bounded by its own deadline.
C++ reverse destruction order of automatic objects holds on returns and unwinds alike.

dispositions.change: Merged with daybreak-blue-R1: same change and regressions (stuck .tombstones entry during an equal-size re-save).
dispositions.rationale: Duplicate root cause; severity taken from the strong critic.
The exclusion only ever applies to requests that become the session's indexed owner.
Verified against the implementation outside the bound paths; only the stale comment was in the delta and is now accurate.

dispositions.change: Release qualification on both lanes will force a checkpoint-tagged eviction (more resident long sessions than fit) and record saved-before-eviction, refused 0 and resume.
dispositions.rationale: Device-only integration path; belongs to the exact-byte qualification gate, not the source review.

dispositions.change: Retry bookkeeping moves into a small AutomaticRetryBudget (serve/checkpoint_policy.h) that every terminal outcome settles, so it only holds sessions with a save still queued; unit test proves it drains to empty.
dispositions.rationale: P2 memory growth under session churn; smallest closure is erase-on-every-terminal-path, made testable.

dispositions.change: Folded into the daybreak-blue-R2 outcome contract: a transient refusal (checkpoint_refusal_is_transient) reports Pending instead of Settled.
dispositions.rationale: Zero extra mechanism once outcomes exist; aligns the saver with its own contract.
Observable exit status for an evicted, unsaved session is unchanged (refused); the only behaviour change is the on-disk skip the packet names.
Availability cost is bounded by the admitted request's footprint (one or two ceiling checkpoints) and the saves complete regardless; recorded as a release limitation.
P3 bounded delay of other automatic saves; pressure saves do not depend on the automatic queue.

dispositions.change: Merged with daybreak-blue-R2: no fixed publication bound remains.

dispositions.rationale: Duplicate of claude-R4; shipped profiles run max_concurrency 1, so no other lane is paused.

residual_risks: A request waiting behind a pending victim can time out while victims are saved or while a slow reader finishes publishing a victim's turn; the saves complete and a retry admits.
Ceiling-class save-before-evict was exercised on the RTX 5090; the RTX 4090 lane runs the same source through its own qualification phases.
The transient-refusal branch of save-before-evict is not exercised at runtime.
A never-stored newer engine tag costs up to six automatic requeues.
review_records_retained: The lead's review records, packets and reviewer outputs are retained outside the repository; this ledger records their dispositions.
